goal: Define and prove a provider-truth-backed durable session resume contract so a later ChatGPT/Codex session can resume autonomous PNCC continuation from fresh canonical state without replaying stale admissions, transactions, leases, branch state or CI conclusions.
scope: define one machine-readable durable resume checkpoint identity bound to fresh current main, selected canonical Work Unit, provider-state head/registry generation, Writer Lease state, bounded branch/PR/CI state and last completed steady-state iteration
require every resumed session to fresh-read provider truth and recompute WU-108 control-loop plus WU-109 execution admission before any mutation
distinguish clean iteration boundary, interrupted transaction, pending provider readback, expired or released lease, branch/PR drift and completed Work Unit states without guessing
forbid replay of a prior session control-loop decision, execution admission, CAS token, branch-head assumption, CI classification or merge eligibility result
define fail-closed reconciliation when durable checkpoint and fresh provider truth disagree, including explicit separate-authority routing for classified failures
keep checkpoint contents public-safe and free of credentials, private runtime evidence, host identifiers or secret-bearing transport data
forbidden_scope: treat a persisted checkpoint as mutation authority or as a substitute for fresh provider truth
resume an interrupted mutation by assuming whether it completed; mandatory provider readback/reconciliation is required first
reuse expired Writer Lease ownership, stale registry CAS tokens, stale PR head or stale CI success after session handoff
broaden existing reusable materialization, Writer Lease, autonomous merge/Issue-close or continuation executor authority
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime, ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: one durable checkpoint schema/policy and fail-closed resume evaluator are machine readable and adversarially tested
fresh provider truth is mandatory at session resume and stale persisted decisions/CAS tokens cannot authorize mutation
clean-boundary resume and interrupted-transaction reconciliation are deterministic and mutually exclusive
expired/released lease, branch/PR drift, pending/failed CI and post-merge states route to the exact current canonical continuation boundary rather than replaying old state
checkpoint contains no private runtime payload, credentials or secret-bearing local evidence
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
